note: Amharic (am) is new to the library and not yet in language_seed.py (added from the admin). Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible, Amharic, Balanced edition (OWB, CC0), bundled as backend/library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline with fetch_verse_text("owb-am", ref) — per the founder decision of 2026-11-18 that every Amharic work quotes OWB. It replaces the 1962 UBS text this bio first quoted.
A `mined` row means the quotation is a verbatim contiguous span of the OWB verse, spliced by script. Book names follow the Amharic library's own citations, not OWB's spellings.

Isaiah 45:22 is quoted as its first clause (the shortest OWB span carrying "Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth"). OWB reads "turn" (ዞር በሉ) where Spurgeon's English Bible reads "look", and the story turns on the preacher's cry "Look!", so a one-time bridging gloss follows the quote in the bio and in the FAQ answer.
